text.text: The first football video games were released in the early 1970s. In 1973 Soccer! was released. on the Odys sey console, created by Tomohiro Nishikado, the creator of Space Invaders, it allows 2 players to each control 2 different rackets in their camp symbolizing a goal and an attacker. But the game is very similar to Pong: 4 rackets in total, but only 1 button per player. It was in 1980 with the release of NASL Soccer on Intellivision that the first real football game appeared. They are played with two teams of six players composed of a handful of pixels which evolve on a green background, but already with the side view

text.name: info1
text.text: Les premiers jeux vidéo de football sortent au début des années 1970. En 1973 sort Soccer ! sur la console Odys sey, créé par Tomohiro Nishikado, le créateur de Space Invaders, il permet à 2 joueurs de contrôler chacun dans leur camp 2 raquettes différentes symbolisant un goal et un attaquant. Mais le jeu est très similaire à Pong : C'est en 1980 avec la sortie de NASL Soccer sur Intellivision qu’apparaît le vrai premier jeu de football.
